name: HoneyLabs honeypot telemetry
operator: HoneyLabs (a sole proprietorship registered in the Netherlands, per honeylabs.net/terms)
tier_rationale: Individual operator whose terms had not been reviewed when the council decided (A8 unknown: anonymous or individual operators); P147 cond 3 'terms unknown, tier unknown' and P170 cond 5 'unknown - HoneyLabs'. A promotion needs a recorded review with reviewer and date (A8).

reliability.justification: Single-operator honeypot telemetry with closed-source collection: reliability cannot be judged until the operator is reviewed (A8 unknown); sightings mean opportunistic scanning, at most MEDIUM alone (P147 cond 6).

honeylabs.description: HoneyLabs API key (keyed IP lookups; free plan)
honeylabs.plan_hint: free HoneyLabs key; unused until legal records HoneyLabs' terms (source honeylabs.api is 'unknown' and disabled in every profile, P147 cond 3)

api.title: HoneyLabs API (CVE, port and ASN telemetry; keyed IP lookup JSON)

terms.quote: they ship as a separate module honeypot_intel_extra (default_enabled=False, terms 'unknown', tier unknown), disabled in every profile until legal records their terms.

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P147 cond 3: the HoneyLabs feed and a second honeypot feed 'publish no licence'; the second feed's name, a person's name, is left out of the registry). Research C0336 terms 'Free community service; API/MCP surface is closed-source; data covers the last ~90 days of their own honeypots.' (verified_live 200). For legal's review queue: honeylabs.net now publishes terms of service ('Last updated 24 November 2026', seen 2026-11-26) whose summary reads 'Use it in your own security work; putting it in a product you sell needs the redistribution licence (section 5).' If cleared: keyless /api/cves/{cve} with 'actors' capped at the top 20 IPs, IP lookups (/lookup/{ip} JSON) only with the free key (P147 cond 4); UDP-derived source IPs never feed verdicts (P147 cond 7); cache CVE answers 6-24 h. Used by honeypot_intel_extra.

lookup_pages.title: HoneyLabs IP report page /lookup/{ip} (manual pivot links, HTML)
lookup_pages.notes: Quote: research C0399 terms (verified_live 200): honeylabs.net/lookup/{ip} HTML report page, not the keyed JSON (P170 cond 8). Manual links only with the 'unknown operator' badge; unknown-tier hosts receive IOC values only (P170 cond 4, 11). Used by pivots_threat_intel.

notes: Shared seed for batches p2-G02-2, p2-G14-1 (P147, P170): batches only extend it (honeylabs__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Tier unknown: never default, excluded at AMBER and above, --allow-unknown at CLEAR/GREEN, IOC_TYPES values only (A8). ttl 6 h: CVE telemetry answers are cached 6-24 h (research C0336). No quota block: the free plan's daily budget is not recorded (honeylabs.net/docs, plans and limits) and the API source is disabled until legal records its terms.
